story.setup: A dark-blue performance coupe joins steady evening highway traffic at ordinary speed.
story.escalation: The road opens and the hero car accelerates while surrounding traffic remains lane-disciplined and believable.
story.turn: Blue hour becomes night as speed, parallax, headlights and traffic density intensify.
story.resolution: The car settles back into a normal cruise among regular traffic under city lights.

visual.style: Stylized 3D automotive short with CC0 Kenney vehicles; no photorealism claim.
visual.lighting: Sunset key progressing into cool night ambience with practical streetlights and vehicle lamps
depth_rules: World-space connected divided highway with persistent lane geometry
Near asphalt/reflectors, hero and traffic vehicles, roadside infrastructure, skyline and atmosphere
typography_rules: Readable opening title and restrained ending credit; no debug overlays
texture_rules: Procedural asphalt grain and repair strips
Authored reflective road furniture, vehicle trim and building-window emission
No claim of external texture assets unless provenance records them

camera.default_behavior: Variable-duration cinematic coverage tied to speed phase; avoid periodic camera cycles

ambience: locally synthesized wind, road noise and traffic bed
effects: locally synthesized engine harmonics, expansion joints and passing-car whooshes
silence_rules: No extended silence; controlled opening and ending fades only
sync_rules: Picture displacement and audio engine/wind derive from the same source/speed-profile.json continuous speed curve
Traffic pass-bys are authored stereo events

known_limits: Direct listening and continuous video perception require available modality
